brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 1792×1008 pixels, 16:9. Raster PNG. This is for バスケまとめ, based on the frozen November 1, 2026 pregame schedule article.

Visual style: approved bold Japanese sports editorial look: nearly black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush diagonal strokes, warm ivory typography, sparse orange basketball accent. Hand-drawn expressive ink linework, black-and-white brush shading, visible pen hatching and rough paper texture. Clearly an illustration, never a photo or photoreal rendering. Minimal elements, high contrast, beautifully typeset with crisp fully correct Japanese.

Subject: exactly one REAL basketball player, Kazuki Hosokawa / 細川一輝 of Gunma Crane Thunders, selected randomly from the current official roster. His identity is for visual likeness only; DO NOT print his name, club, jersey number, performance, or a claim that he will play. Likeness based on the official portrait examined: young adult Japanese man, muscular broad shoulders and strong upper arms, short bleached ash-blond hair with darker roots, tightly short sides and brushed-up slightly swept top, thick dark straight eyebrows, dark narrow almond eyes, straight substantial nose, broad angular jaw and squared chin, medium-full lips, clean-shaven face with faint stubble at most. Preserve these individual features rather than inventing a generic player. The face must be clearly visible and lit in the illustration with a three-quarter frontal orientation.
Dress him in a plain sleeveless dark basketball jersey and dark shorts, with ivory brush highlights and small lime piping; absolutely NO logo, sponsor, crest, team name, brand marking, letters or number on clothing.

Composition: typography fills the left 56%, dynamic athlete occupies the right 44%. Show a powerful low forward-driving dribble stance, torso leaning diagonally inward, bent knees, head raised and eyes forward. His right hand naturally controls one orange basketball low beside the right thigh; the other arm balances the body naturally. Anatomically coherent hands with natural fingers, elbows and shoulders. Head, both hands, entire ball and bent knee must remain comfortably inside the canvas. Crop lower shins deliberately if necessary. No opponents or extra figures. Broad lime brush strokes behind the player provide motion, with simple low court-marking strokes. Do not add a hoop or realistic arena. Scene is a generic imagined pose, not a depiction of an actual game or decisive play. It does not assert appearance in today's games.

Exact visible text, and ONLY this text:
Top left modest brand label: 「バスケまとめ」
Left main headline first line, VERY LARGE lime: 「11/01」
Left main headline second line, VERY LARGE ivory: 「試合予定」
Below headline, readable ivory: 「当日TOP3は公式記録確定後」
Below that, smaller but clear ivory: 「2026.11.01 00:00 JST時点」
Next line, small and legible ivory: 「出場は保証されません」
Bottom footer, clearly legible with comfortable padding: 「イラスト（AI生成）  イメージ」

Keep all text exactly as specified, including numerals, punctuation, Japanese parentheses and Latin uppercase. Do not print quote marks. No other words or numbers. Keep text off the player and ball, 65-pixel safe margins. Footer must not be clipped or hidden. Strong thumbnail legibility and generous negative space.
Article grounding: all games are pregame in the frozen article at 00:00 JST; daily TOP3 are pending official records. No actual stats, ranking winners, featured-player achievement or guaranteed participation may be added. Do not carry over names or scores from other thumbnail examples.

SINGLE CORRECTIVE EDIT
Use case: identity-preserve.
Make ONE corrective edit to input image 1 (the existing basketball thumbnail). Input image 2 is the official portrait of Kazuki Hosokawa, supplied ONLY as a facial likeness reference, never to be pasted into the artwork.

Keep the entire thumbnail composition, palette, ink-and-brush hand-drawn style, exact text, ball, jersey, pose, arms, hands, layout, and date unchanged. Keep the same landscape 16:9 dimensions and deliver a single PNG.

Change ONLY the illustrated player's head/hair/face to more closely match the real individual in image 2. The current head has hair too long and tousled. Use considerably shorter cropped bleached ash-blond hair with dark roots, close clipped sides, a compact neatly brushed-up top as in the official portrait, not long spiky clumps. Match the official portrait's broad angular jaw, squared chin, sturdy neck, thick straight dark eyebrows, dark narrow almond eyes, straight substantial nose, medium-full lips and clean-shaven appearance. Avoid turning him into a generic handsome anime character. Maintain the current three-quarter action head orientation, alert expression and clearly visible face. Preserve strong, distinctive ink brushwork, not photographic skin. Ensure the shortened hair leaves at least 30px of uninterrupted dark/lime background above the head inside the canvas.

Do not reproduce anything from the portrait's uniform: no logos, brands, jersey number, sponsor text, team name, or official photo fragments. Do not put the person's name anywhere. Do not change the existing exact Japanese text:
